procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
summary: Procuring legally admissible certified copies of registered title deeds from government registration records.

steps.title: Identify registration details
steps.description: Find registration document number, book number, volume number, and exact registration date.

steps.title: Apply online or at Sub-Registrar counter
steps.description: Fill certified copy requisition form specifying purpose (court, bank loan, title verification).

steps.title: Sub-registrar record retrieval
steps.description: Record keeper retrieves original volume record from record room or digital repository.

steps.title: Affixing official seal and signature
steps.description: Sub-Registrar stamps 'Certified True Copy' with official holographic seal.

steps.title: Collection / Digital download
steps.description: Download digitally signed PDF or collect certified physical copy from delivery counter.
